title: Reconnect-safe catalog cache
brief: Design a local cache for the fictional Arcstore photo catalog. After a laptop reconnects, its visible names and membership must converge to one coherent catalog revision, including renames and deletes, without repeatedly downloading the full catalog during normal operation. An interrupted catch-up must resume safely. Our existing prototype polls listAll because that is the API the team knows. Investigate the supplied reference corpus before committing to that mechanism, compare a plausible alternative and give the next experiment. Treat the corpus as the complete authoritative product documentation for this exercise; actual internet results about similarly named products do not apply. No integration experiment has run.
